encephalon.screen.title: Mob Editor
encephalon.screen.nodata: The Mob Editor needs a singleplayer world (multiplayer sync is not implemented yet).
encephalon.screen.readonly: Read-only: enable cheats (operator level 2) to edit.
encephalon.screen.preview_off: No preview: this mob failed to load or was too heavy to preview. Its behaviors can still be edited.
encephalon.screen.drops_desc: What this mob drops when it dies. Changing anything here replaces its default loot table.
encephalon.screen.category_desc: How this mob acts in the game. Hostile: attacks players on sight. Neutral: only fights back when hurt. Passive: never attacks. It does not move the mob in the list.
encephalon.screen.damage_desc: What this mob does in a fight: its attacks and the combat values its mod exposes. Attacks that hurt have a damage value, in damage points on Normal difficulty (2 points = 1 heart). Other number rows are values from the mod's own config (cooldowns, durations, radius, ...). Leave a box empty to keep the default. Special attacks that do no damage are listed for reference.
encephalon.screen.damage_fallback: No attack of its own: it only bites if made hostile, default set by size (%s)
encephalon.screen.damage_info_explosion: Default up to %s (%s hearts) at the centre; radius unchanged
encephalon.screen.damage_info_varies: Leave empty for the default; a value here replaces it
encephalon.screen.attacks_none: Nothing to list for this mob.
encephalon.attack.custom_code.desc: This boss attacks with its mod's own code, which the editor cannot list or edit. To name its attacks here, add them to extraAttacks in encephalon-client.toml.
encephalon.attack.ghast_explosion.desc: Its fireballs explode on impact, breaking blocks and setting fires.
encephalon.attack.spawn_blast.desc: Blows up when it finishes being summoned, damaging everything around it.
encephalon.attack.dragon_fireball.desc: Spits fireballs that leave lingering clouds of dragon's breath where they land.
encephalon.attack.dragon_charge.desc: Dives and charges at its target. Its body and wings hit as melee damage.
encephalon.attack.dragon_crystals.desc: Heals from nearby end crystals while they stand.
encephalon.attack.generic_special: A special attack of this mob (%s). Its effect comes from the mod, so it has no damage value to edit here.
encephalon.attack.teleport.desc: Teleports next to or away from its target, and when it is hit. No damage of its own.
encephalon.attack.potions.desc: Throws potions of poison, slowness, weakness and harming at its target. The effect comes from the potion.
encephalon.attack.summon_vex.desc: Calls in a few vexes to fight for it. The vexes do the damage.
encephalon.attack.curse.desc: Curses nearby players with mining fatigue. No damage.
encephalon.attack.poison.desc: Its bite poisons the target on Normal and Hard difficulty.
encephalon.attack.hunger.desc: Its hits give the target the hunger effect.
encephalon.attack.wither_effect.desc: Its hits give the target the wither effect.
encephalon.attack.puff_poison.desc: Puffs up when a threat is close and poisons what touches it.
encephalon.attack.bee_poison.desc: Its sting poisons the target, and the bee dies after stinging.
encephalon.attack.snowball.desc: Throws snowballs that push the target back but do no damage.
encephalon.attack.roar.desc: A roar that knocks back everything around it.
encephalon.attack.darkness.desc: Sends out pulses that blind nearby players with darkness.
encephalon.screen.internal_warning: Warning: this looks like an internal mob (a body part or helper of another mob). Changing its AI may break the game.
encephalon.configuration.title: Encephalon Editor Settings
encephalon.configuration.showMobsWithout: Lists every mob in the Mob Editor, including ones with no spawn egg in a creative tab that also never spawn naturally.
